## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the smallest reproduction.

## Validation

List correctness checks and any skipped hardware checks. Keep experiment reports,
raw measurements, cost calculations and environment snapshots in ignored `artifacts/`. Include
experimental results in a PR only with the owner's explicit authorization.

## Limitations

Record unsupported cases, remaining risks, or follow-up validation. Preserve applicable copyright and license notices
when adapting upstream code. Do not include private data or credentials.
